name: ClubXVR
summary:
Imagine a virtual reality space designed purely for connection and relaxation. 
Welcome to Club XVR, a unique social lounge built especially for VR, where socializing feels natural and effortless and most of all FUN. 
Club XVR is more than just an app; it's a place to unwind, meet new people, and share experiences in a comfortable, immersive setting.
